top_choice_rationale: P005 recognises a general physical-chemical principle: weak, multivalent, reversible interactions drive liquid-liquid demixing and organise the cell interior. It gave a quantitative language (valency, saturation concentration, material properties) that has been reconstituted in vitro by independent groups for about fifteen years. Hyman and Brangwynne made the founding observations and Rosen showed designable, tunable phase behaviour. The in vivo functional case is still debated and Pappu and Mittag are left out, but no other proposal introduces a new concept of molecular organisation. Next I rank the degrader proposals, since induced proximity makes ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis a designable chemical reaction. I place the single-idea P002, whose citation covers the cereblon glue mechanism, above the two-part P001, which pairs unrelated achievements, and I put Liu alone above the synthetic-methods and zeolite options. Any award beats P000.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I am a Lund colleague of committee members Linke and Somfai, but none of the proposed laureates has a stated connection to me.
